2-EPIZOD: 'THE JIVARO INDIANS'
(Xivaro hindulari)

  XIVARO HINDULARI KIM:
  Ekvador va Peru tropik o'rmonlarida yashaydigan
  hindu xalqi. Ular o'z yerlarini himoya qilishi
  bilan mashhur.


EPIZODNING TUZILIShI — YETTI RASM:

  1  Daryoda — timsoh Devidga hujum qiladi
  2  'SNAP!' — Sandra unga eshkak uzatadi
  3  Daryo bo'yida — qutulishdi, lekin hindular
     paydo bo'ldi
  4  Notanish keksa odam — u mashhur Doktor
     Hamperdin ekan!
  5  Doktorning hikoyasi va jurnalistlarning
     maqsadi
  6  Doktor hindularni tushuntiradi va sirini
     saqlashni so'raydi
  7  Londonda — muharrir ularni maqtaydi


EPIZODNING ASOSIY MAVZUSI:
  Tropik o'rmonni HIMOYA QILISh.
  Xivaro hindulari o'z yerlarini, hayvonlarini
  va daraxtlarini saqlashadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR (epizoddan):
  an alligator     = timsoh (Amerika timsohi)
  to be after sb   = kimnidir quvmoq
  to hold on to    = mahkam ushlamoq
  a river bank     = daryo bo'yi, qirg'oq
  scary            = qo'rqinchli
  safe             = xavfsiz
  to panic         = vahimaga tushmoq
  nearly           = deyarli, sal bo'lmasa
  to save          = qutqarmoq
  a rainforest     = tropik o'rmon
  medicine         = dori
  a reporter       = jurnalist, muxbir
  destruction      = yo'q qilish, vayron qilish
  to hurt          = zarar yetkazmoq
  to follow        = ergashmoq, quvmoq
  land             = yer, mulk
  to cut down      = kesmoq (daraxt)
  to destroy       = vayron qilmoq
  to protect       = himoya qilmoq
  a snapshot       = tezkor surat

BIRINChI UCh RASM — ENG KESKIN PAYT.

  1-RASM (daryo, timsoh suzib kelmoqda):
     SANDRA: 'David, over here!'
     DAVID:  'Sandra, help! An alligator is after
              me! My camera!'

  2-RASM ('SNAP!' — timsohning tishi):
     SANDRA: 'Forget your camera. Here, hold on to
              this.'
             (u Devidga eshkakni uzatadi)

  3-RASM (ON THE RIVER BANK — daryo bo'yida):
     DAVID:  'Phew! That was scary, but we're safe
              now.'
     SANDRA: 'I'm not so sure, David. The Indians
              are here.'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Sandra: Devid, bu yoqqa!
  Devid:  Sandra, yordam ber! Timsoh meni
          quvyapti! Fotoapparatim!
  Sandra: Fotoapparatingni unut. Mana, buni
          mahkam ushla.
  Devid:  Uh! Qo'rqinchli edi, lekin endi
          xavfsizmiz.
  Sandra: Men unchalik ishonchim komil emas,
          Devid. Hindular bu yerda.


DIQQAT — 'SNAP' SO'ZINING IKKI MA'NOSI:
  Bu — butun epizodning HAZILI.

  1) SNAP! — timsohning tishini shaqillatishi
     (tovush taqlidi)
  2) a SNAPSHOT — tezkor surat, foto

  Epizodning OXIRIDA bu ikki ma'no birlashtiriladi
  ('It wanted to take some "snap" shots').


GRAMMATIK NUQTALAR:

  'An alligator IS AFTER me!'
     'be after sb' = kimnidir quvmoq, ta'qib qilmoq.
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS emas — 'be after' turg'un
     ibora.

  'HOLD ON TO this.'
     'hold on to' = mahkam ushlamoq.
     Buyruq gap — fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

  'That WAS scary, but we're safe NOW.'
     Bir gapda IKKI zamon:
     'was' (o'tgan — timsoh voqeasi),
     'are' (hozirgi — endi xavfsiz).

  'I'm not SO SURE.'
     'so sure' = unchalik ishonchli emas.
     Muloyim shubha bildirish qolipi.

exercises.explanationUz:
4-RASM (hindular nayza bilan; shlyapali keksa
odam):

     KEKSA ODAM: 'Don't be afraid. There is no need
                  to panic.'
     SANDRA:     'Who are you?'
     DAVID:      'Hey! I know you! You are the
                  famous Doctor Hamperdin.
                  Everybody thinks that you're
                  dead.'


5-RASM (doktor tushuntiradi):

     DOCTOR: 'Well, as you can see, I'm not! I
              NEARLY died, but these people found
              me and saved me. Now I live here with
              them. I'm their doctor. I'm learning
              about the plants of the rainforest.
              It is very interesting. The Jivaro
              Indians use some of the plants as
              medicine. But who are you? What are
              you doing here?'

     DAVID:  'We're reporters. We came here to
              write an article about the
              destruction of the rainforest.'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Doktor: Qo'rqmanglar. Vahimaga tushishga hojat
          yo'q.
  Sandra: Siz kimsiz?
  Devid:  Hey! Men sizni bilaman! Siz mashhur
          Doktor Hamperdinsiz. Hamma sizni o'lgan
          deb o'ylaydi.

  Doktor: Ha, ko'rib turganingizdek, o'lganim yo'q!
          Sal bo'lmasa o'lardim, lekin bu odamlar
          meni topib, qutqarishdi. Endi men shu
          yerda ular bilan yashayman. Men ularning
          shifokoriman. Tropik o'rmon o'simliklari
          haqida o'rganyapman. Bu juda qiziqarli.
          Xivaro hindulari ba'zi o'simliklarni dori
          sifatida ishlatishadi. Lekin sizlar
          kimsiz? Bu yerda nima qilyapsizlar?

  Devid:  Biz jurnalistmiz. Biz bu yerga tropik
          o'rmonning yo'q qilinishi haqida maqola
          yozish uchun keldik.


HIKOYANING BURILISh NUQTASI:
  Hamma O'LGAN deb o'ylagan mashhur olim
  TIRIK ekan va hindular orasida yashar ekan.


GRAMMATIK NUQTALAR:

  'DON'T BE afraid.'
     'be' fe'lining INKOR buyruq shakli:
     DON'T + BE + sifat.

  'There is NO NEED TO panic.'
     'there is no need to ...' = ... ga hojat yo'q.

  'Everybody THINKS that you're dead.'
     'everybody' — BIRLIK → 'thinkS'.
     Bu — ko'p uchraydigan xato manbai.

  'I NEARLY died.'
     'nearly' = deyarli, sal bo'lmasa.
     'I nearly died' = sal bo'lmasa o'lardim
     (LEKIN o'lmadim).
     Kitob bu so'zni QALIN bergan — demak u
     keyingi mashqlarda so'raladi.

  'I'M LEARNING about the plants.'
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS — hozir davom etayotgan
     jarayon.

  'The Jivaro Indians USE some of the plants AS
   medicine.'
     'use sth AS sth' = ... ni ... sifatida
     ishlatmoq.

  'We CAME here TO WRITE an article.'
     'to write' — MAQSAD bildiradi
     (nima uchun kelishdi).

exercises.explanationUz:
6-RASM (hindu Sandraning fotoapparatiga qo'l
uzatadi):

     SANDRA: 'Doctor, stop him! He wants to take my
              camera!'
     DOCTOR: 'Don't worry. He won't hurt you.'
     SANDRA: 'But why are they following us?'
     DOCTOR: 'The Jivaro Indians love their land.
              They don't want anyone to kill their
              animals, cut down their trees or
              destroy their homes. I can help you
              write your article and you can tell
              the world to protect the rainforest.
              But — don't tell anyone about me.
              I'm happy here. I don't want to go
              back.'


7-RASM (BACK IN LONDON — muharrir kabinetida):

     EDITOR: 'Good work, you two. This is a great
              story and the pictures are fantastic.'
     DAVID:  'Well, it wasn't very difficult. What
              do you think, Sandra?'
     SANDRA: 'Oh no, it wasn't. David needs a new
              camera, though. An alligator ate his
              old one!'
     DAVID:  'Yeah! It wanted to take some "snap"
              shots of the jungle.'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Sandra: Doktor, uni to'xtating! U mening
          fotoapparatimni olmoqchi!
  Doktor: Xavotir olmang. U sizga zarar yetkazmaydi.
  Sandra: Lekin nega ular bizga ergashyapti?
  Doktor: Xivaro hindulari o'z yerlarini sevishadi.
          Ular hech kim hayvonlarini o'ldirishini,
          daraxtlarini kesishini yoki uylarini
          vayron qilishini xohlashmaydi. Men sizga
          maqolangizni yozishda yordam bera olaman,
          siz esa dunyoga tropik o'rmonni himoya
          qilishni aytishingiz mumkin. Lekin —
          men haqimda hech kimga aytmang. Men shu
          yerda baxtliman. Qaytib borishni
          xohlamayman.

  Muharrir: Zo'r ish, ikkalangiz. Bu ajoyib hikoya
            va suratlar zo'r.
  Devid:    Ha, unchalik qiyin bo'lmadi. Sen
            nima deb o'ylaysan, Sandra?
  Sandra:   Yo'q, qiyin bo'lmadi. Lekin Devidga
            yangi fotoapparat kerak. Timsoh
            eskisini yeb qo'ydi!
  Devid:    Ha! U jungli suratlarini olmoqchi edi!


HIKOYANING HAZILI — 'SNAP':
  'snap'  — timsohning tishini shaqillatishi
            (2-rasmdagi 'SNAP!')
  'snapshot' — tezkor surat

  Devid: 'It wanted to take some SNAP shots'
  = 'U SNAP suratlar olmoqchi edi'
  Ikki ma'no bir vaqtda: timsoh 'shaq' etdi
  VA 'surat oldi'.

  Bu — SO'Z O'YINI (pun) deyiladi.


GRAMMATIK NUQTALAR:

  'He WON'T hurt you.'
     'won't' = 'will not' — KELASI zamon inkori.
     Doktor ishontirmoqda.

  'Why ARE they FOLLOWING us?'
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS — hozir sodir bo'layotgan.

  'They DON'T WANT ANYONE TO kill ...'
     'want sb TO do sth' = kimnidir ... qilishini
     xohlamoq.
     'anyone' — INKOR gapda ('someone' emas).

  'I CAN HELP YOU WRITE your article.'
     'help sb (to) do sth' — 'to' TUSHIRIB
     QOLDIRILADI.
     'help you to write' ham to'g'ri.

  'you can TELL the world TO PROTECT ...'
     'tell sb TO do sth' = kimgadir ... qilishni
     aytmoq.

  'DON'T TELL ANYONE about me.'
     INKOR buyruq + 'anyone'.

  'An alligator ATE his old ONE!'
     eat → ATE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
     'his old ONE' = 'his old camera' o'rniga.

  'It wasn't very difficult.' / 'Oh no, it wasn't.'
     Sandra Devidning kamtarligini TASDIQLAYDI —
     lekin keyin darrov timsoh voqeasini aytadi
     (ya'ni aslida QIYIN edi). Bu ham hazil.


EPIZODNING XABARI:
  Tropik o'rmonni HIMOYA QILISh kerak.
  Xivaro hindulari o'z yerini, hayvonlarini va
  daraxtlarini asrashadi — jurnalistlar bu haqda
  dunyoga aytishi kerak.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  AN ALLIGATOR
  2  A DOCTOR
  3  CAMERA
  4  SATISFIED


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Devidni timsoh quvmoqda.
  2  Devid va Sandra shifokor bilan uchrashadi.
  3  Hindu Sandraning fotoapparatini ko'rmoqchi.
  4  Mayk mamnun.


HAR BIRI QANDAY TASDIQLANADI:

  1  1-rasm: Devid 'An ALLIGATOR is after me!'
     deydi. Suvda timsoh ko'rinib turibdi.
     'a snake' (ilon) — rasmda yo'q.

  2  4-rasmdagi keksa odam — DOKTOR Hamperdin.
     5-rasmda o'zi aytadi: 'I'm their DOCTOR.'
     'the Indians' chief' (hindular boshlig'i) —
     epizodda umuman eslatilmagan.

  3  6-rasm: Sandra 'He wants to take my CAMERA!'
     deydi.
     'bag' (sumka) — epizodda yo'q.

  4  7-rasm: Mayk (muharrir) 'GOOD WORK, you two.
     This is a GREAT story and the pictures are
     FANTASTIC' deydi → u MAMNUN.
     'disappointed' (hafsalasi pir bo'lgan) —
     teskari ma'no.

  'Mike' — 7-rasmdagi muharrir (redaktor).
  Uning ismi bu betdagi 2-mashqda oshkor bo'ladi
  ('M for Mike').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a snake        = ilon
  a chief        = boshliq, sardor
  satisfied      = mamnun, qanoatlangan
  disappointed   = hafsalasi pir bo'lgan

  A — kesilgan daraxt tanalari uyumi, yog'och

  B — kuygan/o'lik o'rmon, yalang'och tanalar,

  A  →  3   (People cut down trees)
  B  →  1   (the destruction of the rainforest)

  D  →  4   (plants as medicine)


QANDAY ANIQLANDI:

  A: KESILGAN daraxt tanalari va yog'och uyumi
     → daraxtlarni KESISh jarayoni.

  B: Butun o'rmon YO'Q qilingan — faqat
     yalang'och tanalar va loyqa yer qolgan.
     Bu — jarayonning NATIJASI →

  D: Qo'ldagi o'simliklar va DORI TAYYORLASh
     asbobi (hovoncha) → 'plants AS MEDICINE'.


DIQQAT — A va B FARQI:
  A — HARAKAT ('People CUT DOWN trees')
  B — NATIJA ('the DESTRUCTION')
  Rasm A da hali daraxtlar kesilmoqda,
  rasm B da esa o'rmon allaqachon yo'q qilingan.

  'The Jivaro Indians USE SOME OF THE PLANTS AS

  Kitobda 'the Jivaro INDIANS' ishlatilgan.

  ⚠ 'Indian' so'zi Amerika tub aholisiga
  nisbatan Kolumbning tarixiy XATOSIDAN
  kelib chiqqan — u Hindistonga yetib
  keldim deb o'ylagan.

  ⚠ Bugungi to'g'ri variantlar:
     Indigenous peoples
     Native peoples

  ⚠ 'Jivaro' ham tashqaridan berilgan nom.
  Xalqning O'ZI o'zini ShUAR deb ataydi.

  ⚠ Kitob matni asl holida qoldirildi.

exercises.explanationUz:
EPIZODNING QISQAChA BAYONI — o'tgan zamonda.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  David 1) WAS scared BECAUSE an alligator 2) WAS
  after him. David and Sandra 3) WERE on the river
  bank WHEN they 4) SAW the Jivaro Indians with a
  white man. Sandra 5) DIDN'T KNOW him BUT David
  6) RECOGNISED him as Doctor Hamperdin. David
  7) WAS confused SO Doctor Hamperdin 8) EXPLAINED
  that he lived with the Jivaro Indians after his
  accident. He 9) SAID the Indians 10) LOVED their
  land AND they 11) WANTED to protect it. He
  12) PROMISED to help them write their article
  THEN he 13) ASKED them not to tell anyone about
  him.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Devid qo'rqib ketdi, CHUNKI uni timsoh quvardi.
  Devid va Sandra daryo bo'yida edilar, ShUNDA
  ular oq tanli odam bilan Xivaro hindularini
  ko'rishdi. Sandra uni tanimadi, LEKIN Devid uni
  Doktor Hamperdin sifatida tanidi. Devid
  dovdirab qoldi, ShUNING UChUN Doktor Hamperdin
  baxtsiz hodisadan keyin Xivaro hindulari bilan
  yashayotganini tushuntirdi. U hindular o'z
  yerlarini sevishini VA uni himoya qilishni
  xohlashini aytdi. U ularga maqola yozishda
  yordam berishga va'da berdi, KEYIN esa u haqida
  hech kimga aytmaslikni so'radi.


FE'LLARNING JAVOBLARI:
   1  was          (be, birlik)
   2  was          (be, birlik)
   3  were         (be, ko'plik — 'David and Sandra')
   4  saw          (see — NOTO'G'RI)
   5  didn't know  (INKOR)
   6  recognised   (to'g'ri fe'l)
   7  was          (be, birlik)
   8  explained    (to'g'ri fe'l)
   9  said         (say — NOTO'G'RI)
  10  loved        (to'g'ri fe'l)
  11  wanted       (to'g'ri fe'l)
  12  promised     (to'g'ri fe'l)
  13  asked        (to'g'ri fe'l)


DIQQAT — 3-BANDDA 'WERE':
  'David and Sandra' — IKKI odam → KO'PLIK →
  'WERE' ('was' XATO).
  Qolgan 'be' bandlari (1, 2, 7) BIRLIK → 'was'.

DIQQAT — 5-BAND INKOR:
  'Sandra 5) ...... (NOT/KNOW) him'
  → 'DIDN'T KNOW'
  'didn't knew' XATO — 'didn't' dan keyin
  ASOSIY shakl.

DIQQAT — 10 va 11-BANDLAR KO'PLIK EGA BILAN:
  'the Indians LOVED', 'they WANTED'
  Past simple da fe'l ega soniga qarab
  O'ZGARMAYDI.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  be  → was / were
  see → saw
  say → said

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI BOG'LOVChI TANLOVI.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  BECAUSE  (sabab)
  2  WHEN     (vaqt)
  3  BUT      (qarama-qarshilik)
  4  SO       (natija)
  5  AND      (qo'shish)
  6  THEN     (ketma-ketlik)


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  1  'David was scared ...... an alligator was
     after him.'
     → BECAUSE (SABAB)
     Nega qo'rqdi? — chunki timsoh quvardi.
     'and' shunchaki qo'shar edi, sababni
     ko'rsatmasdi.

  2  'They were on the river bank ...... they saw
     the Jivaro Indians.'
     → WHEN (VAQT)
     Qachon ko'rishdi? — daryo bo'yida turganda.
     'so' natija bildiradi — bu yerda mos emas.

  3  'Sandra didn't know him ...... David
     recognised him.'
     → BUT (QARAMA-QARShILIK)
     Sandra TANIMADI ↔ Devid TANIDI.
     Ikki teskari holat.

  4  'David was confused ...... Doctor Hamperdin
     explained ...'
     → SO (NATIJA)
     Devid dovdirab qoldi → ShUNING UChUN doktor
     tushuntirdi.

  5  'The Indians loved their land ...... they
     wanted to protect it.'
     → AND (QO'ShISh)
     Ikki bir-biriga MOS fikr.
     'but' teskarilikni bildiradi — bu yerda
     ikkalasi bir yo'nalishda.

  6  'He promised to help them ...... he asked
     them not to tell anyone.'
     → THEN (KETMA-KETLIK)
     Avval va'da berdi, KEYIN so'radi.
     'so' bo'lsa — so'rash va'daning NATIJASI
     bo'lardi, lekin unday emas.


BOG'LOVChILAR JADVALI (Unit 11, Workbook 45-bet):

  AND      →  qo'shish        (va)
  BUT      →  qarama-qarshilik (lekin)
  SO       →  natija          (shuning uchun)
  BECAUSE  →  sabab           (chunki)
  WHEN     →  vaqt            (... paytda)
  THEN     →  ketma-ketlik    (keyin)


ESLAB QOLISh UChUN — 'SO' va 'BECAUSE' FARQI:
  A BECAUSE B  →  B — SABAB, A — natija
  A SO B       →  A — sabab, B — NATIJA

  'He was scared BECAUSE an alligator was after
   him.'
  = 'An alligator was after him SO he was scared.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL, tartib TESKARI.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the events and put them in the correct order, then tell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Voqealarni o'qing va to'g'ri tartibda joylashtiring, so'ng hikoyani aytib bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BIR VOQEA — IKKALA EPIZODNI qamrab oladi
(1-epizod 'The Waterfall' 68-69-betlar,
 2-epizod 'The Jivaro Indians' 88-bet).

Kitob BIRINCHISINI bergan:
  'Sandra and David got on a plane to Brazil.' — 1


TO'G'RI TARTIB:

   1  Sandra and David got on a plane to Brazil.
      (Sandra va Devid Braziliyaga samolyotga
       chiqishdi.)                        [BERILGAN]

   2  They went to the jungle.
      (Ular jungliga borishdi.)

   3  They heard drums and saw the Jivaro Indians.
      (Ular baraban ovozini eshitishdi va Xivaro
       hindularini ko'rishdi.)

   4  They ran to the river.
      (Ular daryo tomon yugurishdi.)

   5  They found a canoe.
      (Ular kanoe topishdi.)

   6  They fell down a waterfall.
      (Ular sharsharadan qulab tushishdi.)

   7  Sandra saved David from an alligator.
      (Sandra Devidni timsohdan qutqardi.)

   8  They met Doctor Hamperdin.
      (Ular Doktor Hamperdin bilan uchrashishdi.)

   9  Doctor Hamperdin told them about the Jivaro
      Indians.
      (Doktor Hamperdin ularga Xivaro hindulari
       haqida gapirib berdi.)

  10  Sandra and David came back to London.
      (Sandra va Devid Londonga qaytishdi.)

  11  Mike was satisfied with their article.
      (Mayk ularning maqolasidan mamnun bo'ldi.)


QAYSI VOQEA QAYSI EPIZODDAN:
  1-EPIZOD (68-69-betlar):  1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
  2-EPIZOD (88-bet):        7, 8, 9, 10, 11


QANDAY ANIQLANDI — 1-EPIZODDAN:
  • 'Sandra and David are in an AEROPLANE to
     Brazil.'                          → 1-voqea
  • 'I don't like the JUNGLE.'          → 2-voqea
  • 'Can you hear the DRUMS?' +
    'It's the JIVARO INDIANS!'          → 3-voqea
  • 'Sandra, RUN! Let's go to the RIVER.' → 4-voqea
  • 'Look ... a CANOE! Quick! Let's get in it.'
                                        → 5-voqea
  • 'Oh, no! A WATERFALL!' + 'Help!'    → 6-voqea

QANDAY ANIQLANDI — 2-EPIZODDAN:
  • timsoh sahnasi (1-2-rasmlar)        → 7-voqea
  • Doktor Hamperdin bilan uchrashuv
    (4-rasm)                            → 8-voqea
  • doktorning tushuntirishi (5-6-rasmlar)
                                        → 9-voqea
  • 'BACK IN LONDON ...' (7-rasm)       → 10-voqea
  • Maykning maqtovi (7-rasm)           → 11-voqea


DIQQAT — 4 va 5-VOQEALAR TARTIBI:
  Avval DARYO tomon YUGURIShDI, keyin u yerdan
  kanoe TOPIShDI.
  1-epizodda: 'Let's go to the river' →
  'Look ... a canoe!'

DIQQAT — 10 va 11-VOQEALAR TARTIBI:
  Avval LONDONGA QAYTIShDI, keyin Mayk maqolani
  o'qib MAMNUN bo'ldi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a canoe    = kanoe (yengil qayiq)
  a waterfall = sharshara
  drums      = barabanlar
  satisfied with = ... dan mamnun

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in the missing adjectives from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va ro'yxatdan yetishmayotgan sifatlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (5 ta):
  many, large, serious, longest, whole


TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  The Amazon Rainforest is a 1) LARGE beautiful
  forest in Brazil, South America. It lies at the
  mouth of the Amazon River. The Amazon river is
  the 2) LONGEST river in South America. It runs
  between the Andes Mountain Ranges and the
  Atlantic Ocean.

  The Amazon Rainforest is a very beautiful place.
  A wide variety of animals, birds and insects live
  in it. There are also 3) MANY trees and plants.

  Today, the forest has a very 4) SERIOUS problem.
  People are cutting down too many of its trees. As
  a result, much of its animal and plant life is
  disappearing forever. Trees and plants are very
  important to the environment. Some scientists say
  that the 5) WHOLE world is in danger because of
  the destruction of the rainforests.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Amazonka tropik o'rmoni — Janubiy Amerikaning
  Braziliya davlatidagi katta va go'zal o'rmon.
  U Amazonka daryosining quyilish joyida
  joylashgan. Amazonka — Janubiy Amerikadagi eng
  uzun daryo. U And tog' tizmalari bilan Atlantika
  okeani orasidan oqib o'tadi.

  Amazonka tropik o'rmoni — juda go'zal joy. Unda
  turli-tuman hayvonlar, qushlar va hasharotlar
  yashaydi. Shuningdek ko'plab daraxt va
  o'simliklar bor.

  Bugun o'rmonda juda jiddiy muammo bor. Odamlar
  uning daraxtlarini haddan tashqari ko'p
  kesishmoqda. Natijada uning hayvonot va nabotot
  olamining ko'p qismi butunlay yo'q bo'lib
  bormoqda. Daraxt va o'simliklar atrof-muhit
  uchun juda muhim. Ba'zi olimlarning aytishicha,
  tropik o'rmonlarning yo'q qilinishi tufayli
  butun dunyo xavf ostida.


HAR BIR JAVOB QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  'a ...... beautiful forest'
     → LARGE (katta)
     'a' artikli bor → BIRLIK sifat kerak.
     'many' ko'plik bilan keladi → mos emas.
     'longest' va 'whole' 'the' talab qiladi.
     'serious' o'rmon uchun mos emas.

  2  'the ...... river in South America'
     → LONGEST (eng uzun)
     'THE' bor va '... in South America' →
     ORTTIRMA daraja kerak.
     Ro'yxatdagi yagona orttirma shakl — 'longest'.

  3  'There are also ...... trees and plants.'
     → MANY (ko'p)
     'trees and plants' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK →
     'many'.
     'much' bo'lsa sanalmaydigan ot kerak edi.

  4  'a very ...... problem'
     → SERIOUS (jiddiy)
     'a very' bor → ODDIY sifat.
     Muammo haqida → 'serious'.
     Keyingi gaplar tasdiqlaydi: daraxtlar
     kesilmoqda, hayvonlar yo'qolmoqda.

  5  'the ...... world is in danger'
     → WHOLE (butun)
     'the whole world' = butun dunyo.
     Turg'un birikma.


DIQQAT — MATN EPIZOD BILAN BOG'LIQ:
  Devid va Sandra aynan shu mavzuda maqola
  yozgan edilar:
  'We came here to write an article about the
   DESTRUCTION OF THE RAINFOREST.'
  Matnning oxirgi gapida ham aynan shu ibora bor.


MATNDAGI GRAMMATIKA:
  'People ARE CUTTING DOWN too many of its trees.'
     → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozir davom etmoqda)
  'much of its animal and plant life IS
   DISAPPEARING'
     → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
  'TOO MANY of its trees'
     → 'too many' = haddan tashqari ko'p
       (sanaladigan ot bilan)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to lie          = joylashgan bo'lmoq
  the mouth of a river = daryoning quyilish joyi
  a mountain range = tog' tizmasi
  a variety of    = turli-tuman
  an insect       = hasharot
  serious         = jiddiy
  as a result     = natijada
  to disappear    = yo'q bo'lmoq
  forever         = butunlay, abadiy
  the environment = atrof-muhit
  a scientist     = olim
  in danger       = xavf ostida
  because of      = ... tufayli
  the whole world = butun dunyo

⚠⚠ MATNDAGI GEOGRAFIK XATO:

  Kitobda: 'The Amazon Rainforest ...
  LIES AT THE MOUTH of the Amazon River'
  = daryoning QUYILISH JOYIDA joylashgan.

  ⚠ Bu NOTO'G'RI.

  ⚠ Amazon yomg'ir o'rmoni daryoning
  BUTUN HAVZASI bo'ylab yoyilgan —
  taxminan 5,5 million kv. km, TO'QQIZTA
  mamlakat hududida.

  ⚠ Daryoning quyilish joyi (mouth) —
  o'rmonning faqat kichik bir qismi.

  ⚠ To'g'ri ifoda:
     'in the Amazon BASIN'
     (Amazon HAVZASIDA)

  ⚠ 'a mouth' — daryoning dengizga
  quyiladigan joyi. 'a basin' — daryo
  havzasi, ya'ni u suv yig'adigan butun
  hudud.


⚠ Matndagi qolgan geografiya TO'G'RI:
  Amazon — Janubiy Amerikaning eng uzun
  daryosi; And tog'lari bilan Atlantika
  okeani orasida oqadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: DON'T BE + sifat.   /   There is no need TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't be afraid. There is no need to panic.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'be' fe'lining INKOR buyruq shakli.
'There is no need to ...' — biror ish
KERAK EMASligini aytadi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They don't want anyone to kill their animals. He wants to take my camera!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular hech kim hayvonlarini o'ldirishini xohlashmaydi. U mening fotoapparatimni olmoqchi!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'want sb TO do sth' — boshqa odam haqida.
'want TO do sth' — o'zi haqida.

sentencePatterns.formula: I can HELP you + fe'l (to YO'Q).   /   You can TELL sb TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can help you write your article and you can tell the world to protect the rainforest.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men sizga maqolangizni yozishda yordam bera olaman, siz esa dunyoga tropik o'rmonni himoya qilishni aytishingiz mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'help sb (to) do' — 'to' TUSHIRILADI.
'tell sb TO do' — 'to' KERAK.
Farqiga e'tibor bering.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We came here to write an article about the destruction of the rainforest.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz bu yerga tropik o'rmonning yo'q qilinishi haqida maqola yozish uchun keldik.

sentencePatterns.formula: That WAS + sifat, BUT we're + sifat NOW.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Phew! That was scary, but we're safe now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uh! Qo'rqinchli edi, lekin endi xavfsizmiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir gapda IKKI zamon:
O'TGAN voqea va HOZIRGI holat.

sentencePatterns.formula: A + PAST SIMPLE + BECAUSE + B + PAST SIMPLE.   /   A + PAST SIMPLE + SO + B + PAST SIMPLE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: David was scared because an alligator was after him. David was confused so Doctor Hamperdin explained.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Devid qo'rqib ketdi, chunki uni timsoh quvardi. Devid dovdirab qoldi, shuning uchun doktor tushuntirdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'because' dan KEYIN — sabab.
'so' dan KEYIN — natija.
Ikkalasi teskari yo'nalishda.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + ASK + kimdir + NOT TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He asked them not to tell anyone about him.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ulardan u haqida hech kimga aytmaslikni so'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'ask sb NOT TO do sth' — inkor iltimos.
DIQQAT: 'not' 'to' dan OLDIN turadi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Amazon river is the longest river in South America.

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja + 'IN' (joy bilan).
Unit 12 ning grammatikasi.

sentencePatterns.formula: People ARE CUTTING DOWN too many of ... . AS A RESULT, ... IS DISAPPEARING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: People are cutting down too many of its trees. As a result, much of its animal and plant life is disappearing forever.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odamlar uning daraxtlarini haddan tashqari ko'p kesishmoqda. Natijada hayvonot va nabotot olamining ko'p qismi butunlay yo'q bo'lib bormoqda.

PRESENT CONTINUOUS — hozir davom etayotgan
jarayon.

sentencePatterns.formula: The whole world is in danger BECAUSE OF + OT.
